description: This file defines the AttendanceProvider class, a Flutter ChangeNotifier managing attendance state, interfacing with an AttendanceRepository for data operations, and handling real-time updates via SSE from AttendanceRemoteSource.

classes.name: AttendanceProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier that manages attendance data, interacts with a repository for CRUD operations, and subscribes to real-time attendance updates.

methods.name: AttendanceProvider
methods.description: Constructor that requires an AttendanceRepository instance.

methods.name: markNow
methods.description: Marks attendance for a student at the current moment with a status (present/absent) for a specific period.

methods.name: loadDaily
methods.description: Loads and updates the daily attendance list for a given date.

methods.name: loadWeekly
methods.description: Retrieves weekly attendance data starting from a specified date.

methods.name: maybeStartRealtimeRefresh
methods.description: Initiates real-time attendance updates via SSE if the feature is enabled in environment settings.
